slides.headline: “the universe resets on january 1st”
slides.body: jan 1 is a calendar choice, not a sky event. nothing special happens up there at midnight. the sky's fresh start comes a week later: the first new moon of 2027, jan 7, in capricorn.

slides.headline: right now the *moon* is waning, not new
slides.body: it hit last quarter in libra on dec 30 and is still shrinking. on jan 1 the sun meets mercury in capricorn, the closest thing to a sky event that day.

slides.headline: astrologers save *beginnings* for new moons
slides.body: a waning moon reads as finishing and letting go. so the honest astrology of new year's eve: close things now, start them on jan 7.

slides.headline: resolutions are fine. a *new deal* is better
slides.body: there is always an 11:11. it does not have to be midnight.
